summary: Diff against the previously-reviewed head is confined to team-runtime.ts, team-worker-heartbeat.ts, and agent-session.ts, plus tests. The change is a genuine improvement, not a rebase-only churn: heartbeat liveness reporting is generalized from 'follows the top-level prompt in-flight window' to '#refreshTeamWorkerHeartbeat() driven by turn_start/turn_end events plus the owned AsyncJobManager's running-job count', so a worker doing background/subagent work with no top-level Agent.prompt() in flight (e.g. AgentSession-internal dispatch through the yield queue calling Agent.prompt() directly, or a long-running owned async job) no longer goes silent and risks false-stale reclamation by the leader. agent_end without a matching turn_end (failed runs) resets the in-flight counter defensively instead of leaking a positive count that would keep the reporter running forever. The async-job-change listener is registered once and unregistered symmetrically on both dispose paths. team-runtime.ts adds refreshGjcWorkerHeartbeat(), a read/merge/write under the existing team mutation fence that preserves turn_count and correctly resets process_start_time on a pid change; parseHeartbeatStaleMs is exported and reused instead of being duplicated in team-worker-heartbeat.ts.
